clip.a3: 10번 보기 또는 24시간 중 먼저 오는 쪽. 마지막 보기에서 삭제되었다고 알려 줍니다.
clip.a4: 가능합니다. 텍스트는 D1(최대 64KB). 이미지·영상·기타는 S3, 각 32MB까지.
clip.a5: 목록이 없습니다. 링크가 있는 사람만 열 수 있고 만료됩니다.

watermark.a1: 아니요. 브라우저 캔버스에서 처리합니다. 탭을 닫으면 버려집니다. 내보낼 때 EXIF도 제거됩니다.

watermark.a3: 둘 다. 모서리, 가운데, 또는 타일로 반복할 수 있습니다.
watermark.a4: 아니요. 추가만 하며 기존 워터마크는 지우지 않습니다.
watermark.a5: 입력 PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF. 출력 PNG, JPEG, WebP.

collage.a1: 네. 브라우저에서 여러 장을 한 장으로. 업로드 없음.
collage.a4: PNG, JPEG, WebP. 손실 형식은 품질을 조절합니다.
collage.a5: 아니요. 이 탭에서만 처리되고 페이지를 닫으면 버려집니다.

convert.a1: HEIC를 디코딩하는 브라우저(Safari 등)에서는 가능하고 JPG로 받습니다.
convert.a2: 네. HEIC→JPG, WebP→PNG, PNG↔JPG, SVG→PNG, ICO 바로가기가 있습니다.

image-pdf.a1: 네. JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC를 넣어 하나의 PDF로.
image-pdf.a2: 순서를 바꾼 뒤 한 파일을 받습니다.
image-pdf.a3: A4, US Letter, 또는 사진 비율에 맞춘 페이지.
image-pdf.a4: 아니요. 각 이미지는 잘리지 않고 페이지에 맞춰집니다.

audio.a1: 네. M4A, OGG, AAC, FLAC, WebM도 브라우저에서 WAV로 디코딩합니다.
audio.a2: 아니요. Web Audio로 이 탭에서 디코딩합니다.
audio.a5: 아직 아닙니다. 이 도구는 기기에서 비압축 WAV만 씁니다.

data.a1: 네. 예쁘게 또는 압축. 입력하는 동안 변환됩니다.
data.a4: 가능하고 HTML을 Markdown으로도. 복사 또는 다운로드.
data.a5: 아니요. 로컬 파일을 열어도 이 탭을 떠나지 않습니다.

qr.a1: 네. URL이나 텍스트를 넣고 PNG를 받습니다. 이 탭에서 인코딩합니다.
qr.a3: Q, H는 손상이나 로고에 더 강하지만 코드가 커집니다.
qr.a4: 네. 받기 전에 전경과 배경을 고릅니다.
qr.a5: 짧은 URL은 작고, 수백 자도 됩니다. 너무 길면 거절합니다.

password.a1: 네. Web Crypto로 이 탭에서 만듭니다.
password.a2: 아니요. 복사도 기기 안. 탭을 닫으면 사라집니다.
password.a3: 엔트로피는 길이×log2(문자 집합). 16자 혼합은 보통 80비트 이상.
password.a4: 네. 대소문자, 숫자, 기호를 켜고 비슷한 문자도 뺄 수 있습니다.

word-count.a1: 네. 단어/글자, 문자, 문장, 문단, 줄, 200wpm 읽기 시간.
word-count.a2: 한글·한자 한 글자를 단어 1로. 영어는 공백으로 나눕니다.
word-count.a3: 아니요. 로컬 파일도 열 수 있습니다.

resize.a2: 네. JPG 또는 WebP로 품질을 조절하면 예상 용량이 바뀝니다.
resize.a4: 기본은 잠금. 해제하면 임의의 너비와 높이로 늘릴 수 있습니다.
resize.a5: JPG, WebP, PNG. 브라우저가 디코드하면 HEIC / AVIF도 열 수 있습니다.

crop.a1: 네. 사진을 놓고 프레임을 끈 뒤 받습니다.
crop.a5: 선택한 영역의 JPG, PNG 또는 WebP입니다.

color.a1: 네. 색을 고르고 Hex / RGB / HSL을 복사합니다. 이 탭에만 있습니다.
color.a2: Chromium에서는 EyeDropper로 화면 픽셀을 찍습니다. 다른 브라우저는 기본 선택기입니다.
color.a3: Hex, rgb(), hsl()을 파싱합니다. 잘못된 값은 무시합니다.
color.a4: 흰/검에 대한 WCAG 대비. 본문은 보통 4.5:1입니다.

pdf-jpg.a3: 아니요. pdf.js로 로컬 렌더. 탭을 닫으면 버려집니다.
pdf-jpg.a4: 더 큰 비트맵으로 선명하지만 무겁습니다. 작은 파일은 1×.
pdf-jpg.a5: 됩니다. 이미지 페이지는 그림으로, 텍스트 페이지도 래스터화합니다.

merge-pdf.a1: 네. 두 개 이상 넣고 순서를 바꾼 뒤 한 파일로 받습니다.
merge-pdf.a4: 암호화된 PDF는 여기서 종종 합쳐지지 않습니다. 먼저 잠금을 푸세요.
merge-pdf.a5: 페이지는 복사됩니다. 북마크와 폼은 빠질 수 있습니다.

phone-photos.q1: How do I take better iPhone photos?
phone-photos.a1: Wipe the lens, turn on the grid, put light on the subject, get closer instead of zooming, and shoot a set. This 20-minute card is that practice.
phone-photos.q2: Do I need a camera app?
phone-photos.a2: No. The built-in Camera app is enough. Grid and AE/AF lock are already there.
phone-photos.a3: No. Digital zoom crops and softens. Walk closer. Optical telephoto on some phones is a different case.
phone-photos.q4: Is this a paid photography course?
phone-photos.a4: No. It is a free same-day practice card on cv.cm. A cheap multi-skill course supermarket is a weak product; this is one result today.
phone-photos.q5: Can I crop the shots here?
phone-photos.a5: Yes. Use Crop image on cv.cm. The photo stays in this tab.

window-light.a1: Using one window as a soft side light. The near side of the face is bright, the far side falls into shadow, and the eyes pick up a catchlight.
window-light.q2: Can I do this with a phone?
window-light.a2: Yes. Tap the face to expose. You do not need a strobe for a first portrait.
window-light.a3: Clouds are a giant diffuser. Overcast windows are often easier than hard sun.
window-light.a4: Not for this card. A white wall opposite the window is enough fill. A cheap foam board is optional.

crop-compose.q1: How do I crop photos for Instagram?
crop-compose.a1: 4:5 for a tall feed post, 1:1 for the grid, 9:16 for a story. Put eyes on the upper third. The crop tool on cv.cm does this in the browser.
crop-compose.a2: No. Cropping is local to this tab.

badminton-warmup.q1: How long should a badminton warmup be?
badminton-warmup.a1: About ten minutes: easy bounce, joint circles and lunges, shadow swings, then easy rallies. Do not walk on and smash first.
badminton-warmup.q2: Will this teach me to play badminton?
badminton-warmup.a2: No. Video is a front end for warmup, rules, and gear. Playing needs a court, a partner, and usually a coach.
badminton-warmup.a3: If you want to actually play, yes, at least for a few sessions. This page will not replace that.
badminton-warmup.q4: What should I bring to the court?
badminton-warmup.a4: Court shoes with gum rubber, a spare grip, water, and shuttles. Not street shoes.
badminton-warmup.a5: You can. Shoulders and ankles often disagree later. Ten minutes is cheaper than a week off.

badminton-rules.a1: Rally point to 21. You must win by two. At 29–29, the next point wins. Best of three games.
badminton-rules.q2: How do you serve in badminton?
badminton-rules.a2: Underhand, below the waist, racquet shaft down, diagonally into the correct service court.
badminton-rules.a3: Every rally scores, even if you did not serve. That replaced the old side-out system.
badminton-rules.q4: What is the difference in doubles service?
badminton-rules.a4: Doubles uses the short, wide service court. Singles uses the long, narrow one. Even score from the right.
badminton-rules.q5: Does reading the rules make me a player?
badminton-rules.a5: No. This card is so the first club night is less confusing. Footwork is still on court.

pool-safety.a1: No. Do not learn to swim from a webpage. This is a first-visit safety checklist. Book a certified instructor for strokes.
pool-safety.q2: How do I stay safe at a pool?
pool-safety.a2: Lifeguarded water only, never alone, read depth marks, and keep young children in arm's reach.
pool-safety.q3: Can children use floaties instead of supervision?
pool-safety.a3: No. Rings and floaties are toys. They are not a substitute for an adult in touch distance.
pool-safety.q4: Should I learn to swim online?
pool-safety.a4: No. Delivery is the problem, and drowning liability is the reason. Online material can only cover safety and what to bring.
pool-safety.q5: What should I bring to the pool?
pool-safety.a5: Goggles, a cap if required, a towel, and water. Skip alcohol. Confirm a lifeguard is on the stand before you get in.

hub.title: One result today, not a course supermarket
hub.lead: Demand for a quick start is real. A cheap catalog that promises you will play badminton or swim is not. Each card here is one practice you can finish today. Photography you can post. Court warmup and scoring — not a promise you will play. Pool safety — not a swim class. A weekend page that can take a payment. Free.

phone-photos.name: iPhone photography
phone-photos.blurb: Seven shots today that look postable.
phone-photos.title: iPhone photography in 20 minutes
phone-photos.lead: You do not need a course. Wipe the lens, turn on the grid, get closer, and shoot seven frames you would actually post.
phone-photos.result: Seven photos on your phone. Pick three to crop.
phone-photos.note: This is a same-day practice card, not a photography degree. It is free on cv.cm. No purchase.
phone-photos.s1t: Wipe the lens and turn on the grid
phone-photos.s1b: A fingerprint on the lens is the usual 'bad camera'. In Camera settings, turn on the grid so you can place the subject on a third.
phone-photos.s2t: Put light on the face of the subject
phone-photos.s2b: Stand so the window or sun lights the thing you are shooting. If the bright sky is behind it, the subject turns into a silhouette.
phone-photos.s3b: Digital zoom crops and softens. Walk in. Fill the frame with one thing.
phone-photos.s4t: Put the subject on a thirds line
phone-photos.s4b: The grid splits the frame into nine. Place the cup, an eye, or a doorway on a line or a cross — not dead center every time.
phone-photos.s5b: A table object, a doorway, a person or pet if you have one, a texture, a street corner, food, and a close detail. Tap to focus, hold to lock AE/AF, then shoot.
phone-photos.practice: Open Crop image and export three 4:5 frames. Keep the main object on the upper third.
phone-photos.figAlt: Phone photographing roses and a cup by a window, with a rule-of-thirds grid.
phone-photos.figCap: The flowers sit on a third, not in the exact center. Light comes from the window.

window-light.name: Window light
window-light.blurb: One window, a catchlight, a portrait.
window-light.title: Window light portraits on your phone
window-light.lead: One window is enough. Turn off the other lights. Put the subject 45 degrees to the glass and expose for the face.
window-light.result: One portrait (a person, a pet, or a plush) with a catchlight in the eyes.
window-light.note: Same-day practice. You are not booking a studio. Free on cv.cm.
window-light.s1t: Use one window and kill mixed light
window-light.s1b: Ceiling lamps fight the window and turn skin yellow-green. Turn them off. Sheer curtains are a free diffuser.
window-light.s2t: Place the subject 45 degrees to the window
window-light.s2b: The near side of the face is bright. The far side falls into a soft shadow. That is the shape people mean by 'portrait light'.
window-light.s3t: Expose for the face, not the window
window-light.s3b: Tap the face on the phone. If the window blows out a little, that is fine. A dark face is not.
window-light.s4b: A small window reflection in the eyes makes the subject look alive. If the eyes are dead black, turn the face a few degrees toward the glass.
window-light.s5b: Tiny changes in angle matter more than filters. Shoot, step six inches, shoot again. Pick one.
window-light.practice: Photograph a plush or a person by a window. Crop the keeper in Crop image.
window-light.figAlt: A stuffed rabbit on a table beside a bright window, with soft side light.
window-light.figCap: Side window light: one bright side, one soft shadow. No extra lamps.

crop-compose.name: Crop for a feed
crop-compose.title: How to crop photos for Instagram
crop-compose.lead: Cropping is composition after the fact. 4:5 fills a feed. 1:1 fits a grid. Eyes go on the upper third. Do not crop at joints.
crop-compose.result: Three cropped photos: two 4:5, one 1:1, exported in this tab.
crop-compose.note: The crop tool stays in this browser tab. Files are not uploaded.
crop-compose.s1b: On cv.cm, choose Crop image. Drop or paste a photo. Nothing leaves this tab.
crop-compose.s2t: Pick 4:5 for a feed, 1:1 for a grid
crop-compose.s2b: 4:5 is the tall post that uses more screen. 1:1 is the square grid. 9:16 is a story. 16:9 is landscape.
crop-compose.s3t: Put eyes or the main object on the upper third
crop-compose.s3b: A face with too much ceiling looks small. Slide the crop so the eyes sit on the top grid line.
crop-compose.s4b: Cutting a person at the knees, ankles, or knuckles looks accidental. Crop above the joint or include the whole limb.
crop-compose.s5b: Download JPG or WebP of just the selected rectangle. Repeat for two more photos.
crop-compose.practice: Take the seven shots from the iPhone card and keep three crops you would post.

badminton-warmup.name: Badminton warmup
badminton-warmup.blurb: Ten minutes before you step on court.
badminton-warmup.title: 10-minute badminton warmup
badminton-warmup.lead: A warmup is the part video can actually help. It does not teach you to play. You still need a court, a partner, and usually a coach.
badminton-warmup.result: A warmup you can repeat before any game, plus a bag checklist.
badminton-warmup.note: This is a court aid, not a promise you will play badminton. Online video cannot deliver footwork or timing.
badminton-warmup.s1b: Light jog, skip, or side steps around the court. Raise heart rate before you stretch.
badminton-warmup.s2t: Open the joints you will load
badminton-warmup.s2b: Circles: ankles, hips, shoulders, wrists. Ten each way. Then walking lunges and side lunges — badminton is a lunge sport.
badminton-warmup.s3b: Twenty clears and twenty net shots on each side, slow then a little faster. No shuttle needed.
badminton-warmup.s4b: Do not open with smash contests. Short, controlled hits until the shoulder feels warm.
badminton-warmup.s5b: Gum-rubber court shoes, a spare grip, water, and shuttles. Cotton socks. Skip street shoes on a gym floor.
badminton-warmup.practice: Do this warmup before your next booked court. Share the checklist with a partner via Cloud clipboard if you want.
badminton-warmup.figAlt: Top-down diagram of a badminton doubles court.
badminton-warmup.figCap: Doubles court from above: net in the middle, short service line, rear doubles service line.

badminton-rules.name: Badminton scoring
badminton-rules.blurb: 21 points, win by two, how to serve.
badminton-rules.title: Badminton scoring and service rules
badminton-rules.lead: You can keep score after 15 minutes. That is not the same as playing. Use this so the first club night is less confusing.
badminton-rules.result: You can run rally-point scoring and a legal underhand serve.
badminton-rules.note: Reading rules does not make you a player. Footwork, timing, and shot selection need a court and a coach.
badminton-rules.s1t: Rally point to 21, win by two
badminton-rules.s1b: Every rally is a point, whoever served. First to 21 wins the game if they lead by two. At 29–29, the next point wins (30).
badminton-rules.s2b: Match is best of three. Change ends at the end of each game, and in the third game when a side reaches 11.
badminton-rules.s3b: Hit below the lowest rib, racquet shaft pointing down, into the opposite service court. The shuttle must land in.
badminton-rules.s4b: Singles: long and narrow. Doubles: short and wide. Even score, serve from the right; odd from the left.
badminton-rules.s5b: Serve above the waist, hitting the net on the serve without going over, or touching the net with the body or racquet during a rally.
badminton-rules.practice: Watch one match and call the score out loud. Then serve ten legal shuttles on a court.
badminton-rules.figAlt: Top-down diagram of a badminton doubles court.
badminton-rules.figCap: Service courts sit in front of the rear doubles line and outside the singles sideline.

pool-safety.name: Pool safety
pool-safety.blurb: First visit checklist. Not a swim class.
pool-safety.title: Pool safety for beginners
pool-safety.lead: Do not learn to swim from a webpage. Drowning is fast and quiet. This card is what to do before you get in, and why you still need a coach in the water.
pool-safety.result: A first-visit checklist and a clear line: this page will not teach strokes.
pool-safety.note: This is not a swimming course. Video cannot teach you to swim, and it cannot take drowning liability. Book a certified instructor.
pool-safety.s1b: Swim where a lifeguard is on duty. A friend on a phone is not a lifeguard. If there is no guard, do not get in.
pool-safety.s2t: Read the depth marks before you jump
pool-safety.s2b: If you cannot swim, stay in the shallow end and do not jump. Depth changes faster than it looks.
pool-safety.s3b: For young children, an adult stays in arm's reach. Floaties and rings are toys. They are not a substitute for a watcher.
pool-safety.s4b: Goggles, a cap if the pool asks for one, a towel, and water. Skip a heavy meal right before, and skip alcohol.
pool-safety.s5b: A certified instructor in the water is the way to learn strokes. This page stops at safety. That is the honest product.
pool-safety.practice: Pick a lifeguarded pool. Write the checklist on Cloud clipboard. Do not get in until a guard is on the stand.
pool-safety.figAlt: Three pool-safety reminders: never alone, lifeguard, floats are not supervision.
pool-safety.figCap: Three non-negotiables before any first visit.
